learning_outcomes.text: Prepare students for the gradual but stopless coming of nanotechnology and its related techniques in science, technology and practice.
Give students a concept of what nanotechnology is and what constitutes it, how to produce and how to measure it, and the knowledge of when it can be expected to be used in engineering practice.

syllabus_topics: What nanotechnology is: a general review and basic definitions.
Crystal lattices, principles of ordering, indexing of planes.
Scanning probe and electron microscopy techniques.
Limits of optical microscopy and optical methods used for nanotechnology.
What is surface energy and its consequences.
Principles of mask less lithography techniques.
Properties and manufacturing methods of diamonds and graphite.
teaching_methods: 10-minute lecture on selected topic of nanotechnology
bibliography: Jan Hošek, Úvod do nanotechnologie, Nakladatelství ČVUT, 2010.
Charles P. Poole, Frank J. Owens, Introduction to Nanotechnology, John Wiley&Sons, 2003.
Ahmed Busnaina, Nanomanufacturing Handbook, CRC Press, 2007.
degree: Oferta Erasmus+ en inglés de la Fac. de Ingeniería Mecánica (sin plan de grado atado)
